name: D-Resort Sibenik
positioning: Contemporary concrete-and-wood resort by architect Nikola Bašić on the Mandalina peninsula, set in the D-Marin Mandalina marina across from Šibenik Old Town
best_for: Couples or groups wanting a villa with its own plunge pool
Sailors using the marina to explore the Šibenik Archipelago and Kornati National Park

facts.text: The resort is located in the super-yacht marina D-Marin Mandalina and looks out over Šibenik Old Town.
The resort is 30 minutes from some of Croatia's national parks and less than an hour's drive from Split and Zadar international airports.
The hotel is built of white concrete with inserts of wooden planks.
Each villa is different and asymmetric, and from the marina the villas seem to peek out of the rock.
In the rooms, wardrobes, commodes and nightstands are lifted off the floor so the furniture looks like it is floating.
Deluxe Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows, a private balcony with marina views and an open-plan bathroom with a walk-in rainfall shower.
There is a seaside swimming pool next to the Peninsula Grill & Bar.
Motor yachts or sailing boats can be rented from the marina a few steps from the resort to explore the Šibenik Archipelago and Kornati National Park.
The resort has a rooftop running track and table tennis.
D-Gym has Technogym equipment and a group sunset yoga class three times a week.
The spa offers hammam rituals with a raw-silk glove scrub and a foam massage with argan oil and damask rose soaps.
The Roof Bar by Moët & Chandon serves champagne and gourmet bites with views of Šibenik.

highlights.text: The hotel was designed in a winding form to follow the shape of the Mandalina peninsula on which the resort sits.
The resort was designed by architect Nikola Bašić.
The exclusive villas each have a private plunge pool with a wooden deck and views of the marina, plus private parking.
The resort has a heated infinity pool at the Yacht Club overlooking the marina.
The Presidential Suite has a private balcony with 180-degree views over the marina, the city and the sea.

considerations.text: In winter the hotel outlets close and just the Exclusive Sea View Villas can be reserved.
The spa centre is an adults' area; guests under 16 may use just the outdoor facilities.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the resort's luxury positioning.
